evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `resolveLauncher` still binds a lexical absolute path (`resolve(candidate)`) and does not canonicalize symlinks. The function's own comment says this bound path is used for the certification probe and every later launch, while containment is documented as checking the canonical path. That leaves the launch path symlink-bearing, so a retarget after the per-launch containment check can make the host spawn execute a workspace target. The suggested realpath binding is the smallest compatible fail-closed fix; no current-contract clause accepts or retires this race.
